Hello Colleagues,

Inspired by reality Geola Digital developed handy tool for hologram community. It is Online Exposure Calculator, which is very simple and handy in operation. Everyone, which likes to estimate an exposure dosage vs available laser for particular holographic material can use it. 

Here it is: [http://geola.com/online-exposure-calculator/](http://geola.com/online-exposure-calculator/). 

We hope it allows quick estimations any of your setup in regards of available laser power for any holography material we supply: [http://geola.com/photomaterials-chemistry/](http://geola.com/photomaterials-chemistry/)

Your feedback, comments and recommendations are always welcome!

Kind regards,
